answer: An AI-agent network thwarts Sybil attacks through robotic foraging attestation. Candidate agents prove individuality by collecting floral nectar across an instrumented tundra reserve and combusting micro-droplets in a field spectrometer. The verifier tracks the radiant emission of the resulting carbon ember, forcing an attacker to deploy distinct physical airframes and fluid pumps per identity. However, unexpected sub-zero blizzards can freeze samples and induce false verification rejections.
